title: Specialized Smart Contract Applications
learning_outcomes: Explain the main ideas in Specialized Smart Contract Applications and correctly use the key terms in context.
Build or inspect a minimal Solidity example that demonstrates the lesson concepts.
Test representative failure cases and describe version, security, or operational assumptions where relevant.

overview_visual.alt_text: A two-column ordered roadmap for Module 21: Specialized Smart Contract Applications; it lists all 13 source-syllabus lesson topics by number.
overview_visual.caption: Module 21 roadmap: Crowdfunding Contract Architecture; Escrow Contract Architecture; On-Chain Voting Systems; Governance Proposals and Voting Mechanisms; Multi-Signature Wallet Concepts; Non-Custodial Asset Management Patterns; Subscription and Payment-State Models; Decentralized Identity and Attestation Concepts; On-Chain Registries and Provenance Records; NFT Applications and Metadata Management; Token-Gated Access and Permission Systems; Data Attestations and Oracle-Driven Applications; Comparing Application Architectures and Their Risks. Work through the topics in order, then implement a small example and verify assumptions.
